## Où j'en suis
The team built the new dashboards v2 grid on branch `tom/dashboard-grid-v2`: react-grid-layout with drag/resize, per-user layout persisted server-side (PUT /dashboards/:id/layout, debounced, localStorage fallback), and widget sizing via a ResizeObserver hook after container queries proved broken on iOS 15. Widget sizing was switched from container queries to `useWidgetSize`, `DashboardTile` was renamed to `WidgetCard` (deprecated re-export kept), and the Storybook CSS resolution failure was fixed. Draft PR kestrel-analytics/platform#418 is open (last commit `d2286a0`) for Priya's UX review ahead of the Zest demo on Tuesday the 24th.

- [en-cours] PR #418 open as draft, awaiting Priya's UX review on iPad (iOS 15, BrowserStack re-check of `0b9f4e2`)
- [prochaine-étape] Enable `dashboards_v2` flag for the Zest workspace only (config change in flags admin, no code)
- [prochaine-étape] Keep v1 `DashboardList` and the `DashboardTile` re-export until January — nothing removed now (source: t15)
- [essai-raté] Container queries in `WidgetCard`: no effect on iOS 15 Safari (needs Safari 16+); replaced entirely by the ResizeObserver hook (source: t09)
- [essai-raté] First `storybook:build` failed on unresolved `react-grid-layout/css/styles.css`; fixed via `.storybook/preview.ts` import and `optimizeDeps.include`
- [décision] Use `useWidgetSize()` with ResizeObserver and drop container queries completely — no dual systems (source: t09)
